lesson.title: Record and support the assessment
lesson.summary: Separate assessment documentation, registration and responding to competent-authority requests.

prerequisites.reason: The documentation duty belongs to the provider making the paragraph 3 conclusion.
A non-high-risk conclusion must not silently ignore the Annex III profiling override.

blocks: A provider concluding an Annex III system is not high-risk under paragraph 3 must **document the assessment before market placement or service**. The record should show the facts and each legal test supporting that conclusion.
A bare claim 'low risk' is not a documented analysis. This course's practical packet distinguishes scope, use, gateway, condition, profiling and the source version used.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 6(4); Article 49(2), 49(4); Annex VIII Section B

blocks: **Classification registration** is a separate obligation under Article 49(2). The provider, or relevant authorised representative, registers itself and the system before market placement or service.

Documentation and registration are not interchangeable. A report kept internally does not by itself prove registration. Nor does a registration entry establish that the underlying legal reasoning is correct.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 6(4); Article 49(2), 49(4); Annex VIII Section B

blocks: On request, the provider must give competent national authorities the documentation of its assessment. Plan to locate the actual record and supporting evidence.

A person asking informally on the internet is not automatically a competent-authority request. Verify the request and authority; do not confuse this obligation with general public disclosure of every internal document.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 6(4); Article 49(2), 49(4); Annex VIII Section B

blocks: Check the applicable registration fields and access restrictions. Annex VIII Section B points 7 and 9 are deleted in our baseline. Article 49(4) specifies secure non-public registration for stated enforcement/migration contexts and still contains a cross-reference to point 9.

Record that textual cross-reference issue; do not invent a deleted field. The documentation duty remains. Application dates and the exact secure-section context require their own check before making a real filing.
